limitations: About two months of prices: enough for a first view, not proof across market regimes; 4h trade counts may be very small.
No tuning or automatic model selection; current and earlier market/Strict outcomes were already visible. Final chronological window is not pristine prospective evidence.

Each strategy has the same 300 EUR capital and risk limits. Passive buy-and-hold targets equal weights but may leave cash due to volume participation limits; no stops, so its risk/exposure differs. Stress changes both costs and liquidity, so lower stress losses do not demonstrate cost robustness.
All costs and liquidity are modeled. Spot only, previous 5m volume participation, next 5m open, adverse stop slippage and stop-first intrabar policy.
Max hold 168h for all six models; positions open at cutoff remain censored. Marked return includes estimated liquidation costs; mean R counts closed trades only.
A higher-timeframe candle is rejected if any underlying 5m candle is missing; no interpolation. Indicator history resets on missing higher bars.
Candle revisions use the existing original-cache-first policy and remain explicitly logged; affected windows including warmup are flagged.
Four fixed major assets are a chosen research universe, not an exhaustive or survivorship-free exchange universe.
Frozen engines/protocols and live trading are unchanged. No orders or deployments.

protocol.benchmarks: EUR cash and buy-and-hold targeting equal weights in the four assets, using the same modeled costs and volume participation. Actual fills can leave uninvested cash and unequal weights; exposure is reported. No stops or open-risk constraint on passive reference; it is not a risk-matched strategy competitor.
protocol.dataPolicy: Reuse existing cache and original-vintage priority unchanged. Record revisions and flag affected windows including indicator warmup. Missing bars remain absent. Reject checksum corruption.
protocol.documentationAmendment: After first outcomes, expose actual passive investment/cash and correct the full-exposure description. No model rule, threshold, execution price, portfolio constraint or prior economic result is changed.

families.breakout: EMA20>EMA50; current close>maximum HIGH of preceding 20 completed bars; volume>=mean preceding 20 volumes. Stop=close-2*ATR14, target=close+3 structural R.
families.mean-reversion: Previous close below previous Bollinger lower20 (2 population stdev); current close reclaims current lower20; SMA-RSI14<=40. Stop=close-2*ATR14; target=EMA20.
families.trend-pullback: EMA20>EMA50; previous close<=previous EMA20, current close>current EMA20. Stop=close-2*ATR14, target=close+3 structural R.

protocol.inference: Historical exploratory comparison; no parameter optimization, no automatic winner. Overview overlaps the splits and is not independent validation. Chronological final window is retrospective, not pristine prospective evidence. Future data after cutoff remain unevaluated.
protocol.safety: Research branch only. No frozen engines/protocol edits, no live changes, orders, deployment or main merge.
protocol.signalConventions: Only complete UTC-aligned higher-timeframe bars with all underlying 5m bars; no gap filling. Require 60 consecutive higher-timeframe bars. EMA recalculated on latest 60 bars; previous EMA on the preceding 60 bars when available, otherwise preceding 59. Signal rising edges only; available at higher-bar close+1ms. No Strict BUY journal dependency.
